seo.title: Services - CorosDev
seo.description: Explore the elite technology services and strategic frameworks of CorosDev - AI automation, custom software, digital growth, and scalable systems.

hero.sub: We don't just deliver services. We engineer competitive advantages. Each engagement is powered by a proprietary framework that connects technology, growth, and scale.

methodology.label: How We Operate
methodology.sub: Our methodology is what separates us from a typical software agency. We operate as a strategic partner, not a vendor.
methodology.step1_desc: We begin with a deep technical and business audit. We identify bottlenecks, opportunities, and your competitive moat before writing a single line of code.
methodology.step2_desc: We design scalable systems with future growth in mind. Architecture decisions are driven by data, not trends — ensuring your tech stack remains an asset, not a liability.
methodology.step3_desc: Agile sprints. Dedicated teams. Transparent communication. We ship fast without sacrificing quality, giving you a competitive edge in days, not months.
methodology.step4_desc: Post-launch is where we differentiate. Continuous optimization, performance monitoring, and strategic growth ensure your platform evolves ahead of the market.

engagements.label: Our Engagements
engagements.sub: Elite technology solutions designed to fit your unique business stage. Choose your impact level.
engagements.item1_desc: Boost operational efficiency by 40% with intelligent agents and custom GPT integrations tailored to your data.
engagements.item2_desc: End-to-end product creation from MVP to enterprise scale. We build software that feels like the future.
engagements.item3_desc: Dominate the market with high-converting landing pages and automated multi-channel marketing systems.
engagements.item4_desc: Turn search engines into your biggest revenue source with aggressive technical SEO and content strategy.
engagements.item5_desc: Scale to millions of users with zero downtime. We optimize your cloud for speed, security, and cost.
engagements.item6_desc: A dedicated high-performance team covering all fronts: AI, Dev, Growth, and Infrastructure. Your tech partner for global dominance.
engagements.custom: Looking for something custom? All plans can be tailored to your specific requirements.

seo.title: Ecosystem - CorosDev
seo.description: Explore the CorosDev ecosystem. We build our own high-tech internal ventures alongside our client services: Accesorios TRD, Snapay, and Vorzana.

hero.label: Internal Ventures
hero.sub: Beyond client work, we build our own products. These are the ventures born inside CorosDev, each solving a real problem at scale.

ventures.trd_desc: Premium automotive accessories e-commerce platform built for performance enthusiasts across LATAM and North America. Curated catalog, fast logistics, and a seamless buying experience.
ventures.trd_detail: Accesorios TRD was born from a real gap in the LATAM market: premium automotive parts with no trustworthy online destination. We built the entire platform — storefront, logistics integrations, and inventory management — in-house.
ventures.snapay_desc: A next-generation payment infrastructure for SMEs in emerging markets. Instant settlements, multi-currency support, and AI-powered fraud prevention - built to democratize fintech.
ventures.snapay_detail: Snapay addresses the fragmented payment landscape in LATAM where 60% of SMEs remain underserved by traditional banking. Our API-first architecture enables any merchant to accept payments in under 10 minutes.
ventures.vorzana_desc: An AI-powered business intelligence platform that transforms raw operational data into strategic insights. Custom dashboards, predictive analytics, and automated reporting at enterprise grade.
ventures.vorzana_detail: Vorzana emerged from the operational pain our own clients faced: drowning in data but starving for insight. We built an AI layer that speaks your business language, not technical jargon.

cta.p: We are actively building strategic relationships with capital partners, sector experts, and distributors to scale these internal ventures globally.

seo.description: Meet CorosDev's strategic partners across technology, capital, and data — EncryptedInfoWeb, SBC Capital, AUDELA Control Tower, Nolim Studios, and The Intellify.

hero.label: Strategic Alliances
hero.sub: We build alongside a trusted network of technology, capital, and data companies — extending what CorosDev can deliver for every client and venture.

grid.eiw_desc: Custom web development, mobile apps, and enterprise ERP/CRM software — delivering data-driven solutions across real estate, healthcare, finance, and e-commerce.
grid.sbc_desc: A private acquisition firm investing in lower middle-market businesses across the U.S. and Europe, acting as permanent, long-term owners.
grid.audela_desc: A French software company delivering Business Intelligence, ERP, and LegalTech solutions through its unified Control Tower platform.
grid.nolim_desc: A software development studio building custom software, AI systems, AR/VR experiences, SaaS platforms, and games — from air traffic systems to judicial education platforms.
grid.intellify_desc: An AI and digital product engineering company building intelligent automation, AI agents, and modernized platforms for enterprises across regulated industries.
